status.en: 13 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Bangkok, Chiang Rai and Pattaya.
status.nb: 13 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Bangkok, Chiang Rai og Pattaya.

summary.en: In the past week there have been 13 armed incidents, mainly in Bangkok, Chiang Rai and Pattaya, with none reported by multiple outlets, and the UCDP recorded 35 battle‑related deaths in 2024. The conflict in southern Thailand continues amid broader regional tensions, including reports of cross‑border crime, refugee concerns and infrastructure projects linking Thailand with neighboring countries. Recent headlines also note a Thai‑Cambodian border dispute, a poison‑flow issue from Burma affecting the Chiang Rai river basin, and a high‑profile repatriation of a Filipina trafficking victim from Thailand.
summary.nb: I løpet av den siste uken har det vært 13 væpnede hendelser, hovedsakelig i Bangkok, Chiang Rai og Pattaya, uten at noen ble rapportert av flere medier, og UCDP registrerte 35 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024. Konflikten i sørlige Thailand pågår fortsatt midt i bredere regionale spenninger, inkludert rapporter om grenseoverskridende kriminalitet, flyktningbekymringer og infrastrukturprosjekter som knytter Thailand til nabostatene. Nylige overskrifter nevner også en thai‑kambodsjansk grensediskusjon, et gift‑flyt‑problem fra Burma som påvirker Chiang Rai‑elven, og en høyt profilert repatrieringssak av en filippinsk menneskehandels‑offer fra Thailand.

background.title: Southern Thailand insurgency
background.extract: The Southern Thailand insurgency is an ongoing conflict centered in southern Thailand. It originated in 1948 as a separatist insurgency in the historical Malay Patani Region, made up of the three southernmost provinces of Thailand and parts of a fourth, but has become more complex and increasingly violent since the early 2000s from drug cartels, oil smuggling networks, and sometimes pirate raids.
